name: How should I prepare my home before a bathroom waterproofing contractor arrives?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a bathroom waterproofing contractor arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a remodeling team begins waterproofing, remove all personal items, toiletries, bath mats, and window treatments from the space. Clear a pathway from the exterior entryway to the bathroom so technicians can carry boards, mortar, and tools without obstruction. If your home has an older bathroom, ask the contractor to inspect the subfloor framing once the old shower is torn out. Addressing existing mold, plumbing leaks, or rotted floor joists before applying the new waterproofing system ensures your new shower rests on a sound foundation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, clear a walkway for the crew, and prepare for framing inspections after demolition to address any preexisting moisture issues.
